form:FormGroup.label: Embedding Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: The AI model used to turn this field's text into vectors, both when indexing and when building a query. Choose an OpenAI model document.

form:FormGroup.label: Vector Similarity Function Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the similarity between two vectors is measured when indexing and searching: Euclidean distance, Dot product, Cosine similarity or Maximum inner product. Dot product needs all vectors normalised to unit length. Default is Dot product.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: How vector similarity is measured. Dot product needs normalised vectors.

form:FormGroup.label: Segment Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum size of each segment that the field's text is split into before it is converted to vectors, in tokens. Default is 2000.

form:FormGroup.label: Overlap Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that adjoining segments share, so that context is not lost at a split. Only whole sentences are included in the overlap. Default is 200.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Maximum overlap between segments in tokens. Whole sentences only.

form:FormGroup.label: Nearest Neighbour Count
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of nearest neighbours (most similar vectors) to return for a vector query. Default is 10.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number of most similar vectors to return per query.

form:FormGroup.label: Reranking Model
form:FormGroup.helpText: The AI model used to rerank the results of a vector search by relevance. Reranking only happens when the query asks for the field's rerank score. Choose an OpenAI model document.

form:FormGroup.label: Rerank Model Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The kind of service the reranking model runs on: Jina, Cohere or Open AI. Default is Open AI.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Service the reranking model runs on.

form:FormGroup.label: Rerank Batch Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of search results sent to the reranking model in each request. Default is 1000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number of results sent to the reranking model per request.

form:FormGroup.label: Minimum Rerank Score
form:FormGroup.helpText: Results scoring below this value are removed after reranking. Enter a decimal number; anything else is treated as the default. Applies to Jina and Cohere models only. Default is 0.8.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Decimal number. Jina and Cohere only. Default is 0.8.
